name: Explorer 35
about: Explorer 35 (1967-070A, GSFC), launched 1967 Jul 19. Its phases from GCAT: Luna. Orbits keep GCAT's shape and inclination; their orientation and the place along them are estimated.

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was
